text: Team column cut: every request read Ready in a blue pill.
One status a request (Ready, Flagged, Accepted) in the tracker's words; the determination is plain ink text beside it.
Due dates are toned only when overdue; v1 drew the flagged requests' due dates amber.
The quick views count the same 368 requests as the tracker: All 368, Ready 88, Flagged 54, Accepted 226 (v1: All 14).
Nothing is ticked when the page opens; the filters show (Control, Owner, Status, Due date) until a row is ticked.
The tracker's Ready segment is grey like its pill, not blue.
Export left the filter row; it stays in the header's ⋯ menu as Export requests.
A request's page: one Status pill and six facts; Team status and Assessor merged, Determination in ink.
Assignment donut at 0% cut; No owner 560 is a quick view instead.
One summary card, Controls satisfied, without its three mini tiles; drawn as one band.
Next step is the words alone: the glyph that repeated the Status pill is gone; no step prints —.
Five quick views (All, Needs evidence, Not assessed, Short of satisfied, No owner); No requirement and Inherited are filter values.
Nothing is ticked when the page opens; the filters show.
Header keeps one primary and one secondary: Export moved into the ⋯ menu.
Nothing between the facts and the tabs: Where it stands and Next step are the first tab's Details rail.
One primary on the page (Add evidence); Next step's Open assessment campaign is a secondary.
The red CVE callout left the Next step card; the operational issue stays on the Findings tab.
Each fact once: Implementation Partial and the parameter's Not set left the facts row; four facts, one status pill.
Where it stands is plain numbers: no 0% bar, mini tiles or trace counts that repeated the tabs.
Overdue is one mark, the Status pill: due dates are plain days, no red flag, failing counts in ink.
No eye icon in every row; the preview moved into each row's ⋯ menu. The category rail keeps its red counts.
Nothing is ticked when the page opens; the filters show.
Control status is a glyph and an ink word, as Vanta draws it; the version's state is the row's one pill.
One toolbar line: four filters and + Add filter; the Require my approval box and Sort by left (v1 wrapped to two lines).
Banner gone: No approver 12 is a quick view, Assign approvers sits in the ⋯ menu and beside the filters on that view.
Five counted quick views (v1: six, uncounted); In review and Approved are Latest version filter values.
Renew by is a plain day, so a row tones two cells at most; empty Approver prints —, 0 of 23 has no ring.
Not applicable and Not required are grey words, not blue pills.
Direction moved to the service's preview so the table fits at 1440 and Owner is no longer cut off.
One row of quick views (status); CAT is a filter beside the search instead of a second chip row.
Filtered to Open, the table drops its Status column: every row said Open.
The blue DISA release banner is one line under the title, with See what changed as a link.
Seven tabs: History and Comments are one Activity tab, so the strip never folds into More; both addresses still open it.
The STIG rules and objectives tables keep the full width below the rail, so they fit their frame at 1440.
Rule title and finding details are cut shorter, so the rules table fits beside the rail at 1440.
Both banners (newer DISA release, queued checklist file) are plain lines under the title with their actions as links.
Each live table's bar is one grey line under its section title; Open record, History and Detach show on pointing or focus.
Contents drops the ring, live icon and collaborator dots on every row; one amber dot marks a section that needs action.
Counts in Contents are grey; the amber placeholder chips are gone (the count is in the dot's tooltip).
Collaborator avatars in the header are neutral initials without coloured rings; their colour stays on their cursor.
Revision 3 · Draft · SYS-WSX90 is one grey line beside the title (v1: three chips, Draft in amber).
Each control's implementation and status are grey words in its meta line, not two toned pills; action chips keep their tone.
The page's Managed / Found in SBOMs tabs are gone: three rows above the table (area strip, quick views, filters).
Found in SBOMs is the last of five quick views; Component sets is a Kind filter value; four filters (Flag is the Flagged view).
The SBOM list shows the same quick views instead of tabs; a view opens Suppliers already filtered.
